opening.argument: The speaker directly urges viewers to put money into BitConnect’s lending program, recommends investing at least $100, and presents his own earnings as support. He says, “I recommend at least throwing $100 into this” and “I made 132 dollars and 73 cents.” He then extends that positive account to others, saying he expects them to do fairly well, and promotes reinvesting during the first 16 days. Although he criticizes other high-return mining and investment offers, those warnings do not undo his direct promotion of BitConnect or his encouragement to participate. The message is an endorsement of an investment pool and its returns, not merely a caution about other offers.
